remarks: Welcome to 193B Park Street, a spacious 4-bedroom condominium offering spectacular year-round views of New Canaan's beloved Mead Park. With direct access to the park's scenic walking paths, playground, tennis and pickleball courts, pond, and the popular Apple Cart Cafe, this home delivers the perfect blend of nature, convenience, and in-town living. Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully designed across three finished levels, this residence features sun-filled living spaces, an attached garage, and a flexible floor plan suited for today's lifestyle. The main level offers a bright and airy living room, an updated eat -in kitchen, both with picture-perfect park views, in addition to a dining room and powder room. Upstairs, you'll find 2 bedrooms with walk-in closets that share a full bath, and a serene primary suite over looking Mead Park.  The walk-out lower level provides a spacious family room and a 4th bedroom with direct access to Mead Park-an ideal spot for effortless indoor-outdoor living, play, and entertaining. Enjoy the rare opportunity to live steps from downtown New Canaan's shops, restaurants, train, and schools-all while overlooking one of the town's most treasured green spaces. A unique offering that combines convenience, charm, and an unbeatable setting.
